rule: A frozen contract's `frozen_artifacts.tool_sha256` names the tool bytes in force at THAT contract's freeze. When the tool is re-pinned by a later round, the frozen contract is never edited (append-only evidence); instead the re-pin is recorded here, naming the contract, the path, the old and the new digest, and the round that re-pinned it. Any contract pin with no matching entry here is an unreconciled self-assessment mismatch (round-35 C2 counter class m4).

entries.why: round-34 seat ReviewPinChain F1: the counter's own TOOL_SHA256 constant (7b11ba25...) governs measurement, but the round-33 contract still cited the f6d8a891 blob (9dbbce62...), so a literal contract verifier would score the tree FAIL. The contract bytes stay frozen; the rule above governs future re-pins.
